Description:

**Job Title:** System Analyst

**Organization Name:** NEC Corporation India pvt. Ltd.

**Reporting Relationship:** Project Manager

**Role Summary****:**  
We are seeking a highly motivated Service Engineer to provide exceptional technical support and customer service to our clients. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing incidents and service requests, ensuring timely resolutions within defined Service Level Agreements (SLA), and maintaining a high level of customer satisfaction.

**Key Responsibilities****:**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for all incidents, service requests, and inquiries, ensuring each has a designated owner and is resolved within the SLA.
* Monitor, track, and manage issues through the CRM process, ensuring no incidents get bottlenecked and are resolved efficiently.
* Provide support by understanding customer needs, mapping workflow processes, and analyzing technical requirements or gaps.
* Analyze technical problems reported by end users via email, calls, or chat, and provide the first level of business perspective solutions.
* Ensure continuous support to clients and stakeholders, proposing resolutions and managing customer expectations.
* Track all cases to ensure timely responses, maintaining updates on incident status, progress, and history in the CRM.
* Monitor ongoing service requests and incidents, ensuring timely communication to end users.
* Collaborate with senior teams and stakeholders to resolve escalated issues and monitor the status of incidents.
* Ensure contributions towards the overall Total Customer Experience are met and maintain a high standard of service quality.
* Create and update knowledge base articles to document solutions for recurring issues.
* Ensure stability of the network and hardware infrastructure by monitoring and troubleshooting when necessary.
* Support Project Management Office (PMO) activities by maintaining project trackers, preparing status reports, and coordinating action items with project teams.
* Assist with PMO governance by tracking milestones, risks, issues, and dependencies, maintaining project documentation, and escalating delays to the Project Manager.
  

**Skills, Knowledge, and Experience****:**

* ITIL Knowledge: Case management, ticketing tool lifecycle experience.
* Technical Tools: Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word), and experience with computerized data entry and network monitoring tools.
* Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
* Customer Service: Experience managing service requests and incidents, meeting quality assurance requirements and performance metrics.
* Strong customer-facing ability: Confidently engage with clients, communicate technical issues clearly to non-technical audiences, manage expectations, and build trusted relationships through proactive updates and professional handling of escalations.
* Certifications: Any ITIL and Automation certified professionals will be preferred.
* Availability: Ability to work in a 24/7 environment and in rotational shifts.
  

**Specialization Description**
------------------------------

Contact Center Customer Service: Non-Technical provides post-sale non-technical customer service to business or end-consumer customers via phone, online chat, or text including:

* Responding to a high volume of low complexity general inquiries (e.g., general product and pricing information, billing issues, warranties, etc.)
* Providing responses to customer inquiries based on pre-determined scripts and other response guidance tools
* Recommending alternative products or services (e.g., warranties) as part of customer issue resolution This position is not compensated based on achievement of sales targets. Work Environment: Typically located in a call center environmentSpecialization Match Note: Match incumbents in call center positions that focus 100% on new order processing to the Order Processing specialization in the Sales Operations/Administration sub-family in the Sales, Marketing & Product Management job family. These positions are typically Business-to-Consumer (B2C) and exist in cases where the customer is asked to select between:
* Assistance with a new order (call is routed to the Order Processing specialization)
* Assistance with an existing order (call is routed to this specialization)

**Level Description**
---------------------

An experienced support level position that requires a basic knowledge of a given job area and tools, typically seen through work experience as well as vocational or technical training. Works under moderate supervision. Problems are typically of a routine nature, but may at times require interpretation or deviation from standard procedures. Communicates information that requires some explanation or interpretation to achieve business results for a given area of a department or function.

Headquartered in Japan, NEC is a leader in the integration of IT and network technologies. With over 123 years of expertise in providing solutions for empowering people, businesses, and society, NEC stands tall as a champion in enabling change and transformation across the globe. Present in India since 1950, NEC has been instrumental in burgeoning India’s digitization journey continually for the past 70 years.

  

NEC India has proved its commitment to orchestrating a bright future through its diverse businesses from **Telecommunications to Public Safety, Logistics, Transportation, Retail, Finance, Unified Communication and IT platforms**, serving across the public and private sectors. NEC India, through the deployment of cutting-edge technology, has been powering India in seminal ways, making lives easier, safer, and more productive for all.

  

With its Centre of Excellence for verticals like **Analytics platform solutions, Big Data, Biometrics, Mobile and Retail**, NEC India brings to the table, innovative, seamless solutions for India and across the world.

  

NEC India is headquartered in New Delhi and has its offices panned across the country. It has branches in **Ahmedabad, Bengaluru, Chennai, Mumbai, Noida and Surat.**

IT & Networking Solutions, Unified Communication Solutions, Safety and Security Solutions, Integrated Retail Solutions, Data Centre Solutions, Safe and Smart City Solutions, Transportation Solutions, SDN Solutions, Carrier Telecom Solutions, and Solutions for Society.

title: Director, AI/ML
description:
Posted date Nov. 09, 2026

Contract type Full time

Job ID R-263794

  

**Why choose AstraZeneca India?**
---------------------------------

Help push the boundaries of science to deliver life-changing medicines to patients. After 45 years in India, we’re continuing to secure a future where everyone can access affordable, sustainable, innovative healthcare.

The part you play in our business will be challenging, yet rewarding, requiring you to use your resilient, collaborative and diplomatic skillsets to make connections. The majority of your work will be field based, and will require you to be highly-organised, planning your monthly schedule, attending meetings and calls, as well as writing up reports.

**Who do we look for?**
-----------------------

Calling all tech innovators, ownership takers, challenge seekers and proactive collaborators. At AstraZeneca, breakthroughs born in the lab become transformative medicine for the world's most complex diseases. We empower people like you to push the boundaries of science, challenge convention, and unleash your entrepreneurial spirit. You'll embrace differences and take bold actions to drive the change needed to meet global healthcare and sustainability challenges.

Here, diverse minds and bold disruptors can meaningfully impact the future of healthcare using cutting-edge technology. Whether you join us in Bengaluru or Chennai, you can make a tangible impact within a global biopharmaceutical company that invests in your future. Join a talented global team that's powering AstraZeneca to better serve patients every day.

**Success Profile**
-------------------

Ready to make an impact in your career? If you're passionate, growth-orientated and a true team player, we'll help you succeed. Here are some of the skills and capabilities we look for.

### **Tech innovators**

Make a greater impact through our digitally enabled enterprise. Use your skills in data and technology to transform and optimise our operations, helping us deliver meaningful work that changes lives.

### **Ownership takers**

If you're a self-aware self-starter who craves autonomy, AstraZeneca provides the perfect environment to take ownership and grow. Here, you'll feel empowered to lead and reach excellence at every level — with unrivalled support when you need it.

### **Challenge seekers**

Adapting and advancing our progress means constantly challenging the status quo. In this dynamic environment where everything we do has urgency and focus, you'll have the ability to show up, speak up and confidently take smart risks.

### **Proactive collaborators**

Your unique perspectives make our ambitions and capabilities possible. Our culture of sharing ideas, learning and improving together helps us consistently set the bar higher. As a proactive collaborator, you'll seek out ways to bring people together to achieve their best.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**Job ID** R-263794 **Date posted** 11/09/2026

**Job Title:** DIRECTOR, AI/ML

**GCL:** F

**Location:** Bangalore

**Introduction to role:**

Are you ready to set the technical bar for AI systems that shape how life-changing therapies reach patients? In this senior individual-contributor role based in Bangalore, you will be the technical authority guiding advanced AI across our commercial landscape—from traditional ML to Generative and agentic AI—turning breakthroughs into measurable outcomes for patients and the business.

You will lead through influence, not headcount, defining architecture, standards and strategy while pairing that with hands-on expertise. Partnering with colleagues across Commercial, Medical and Technology, you will help transform diverse data—patient, physician, health systems, sales and scientific content—into rigorous, scalable AI that drives better decisions at pace. How would you design resilient AI systems that are trusted, governed and production-ready from day one?

**Accountabilities:**

* Technical Vision and Architecture: Define and drive the technical vision, roadmap and architecture for traditional ML, Generative AI and agentic AI capabilities, aligned to enterprise strategy and commercial priorities.
* Multi-functional Leadership: Provide hands-on technical leadership to project teams; set design direction, review architectures and code, and remove blockers on sophisticated problems.
* Agentic AI Systems: Lead the design of multi-agent systems and LLM applications, including orchestration, tool use, memory, guardrails and human-in-the-loop patterns.
* Evaluation Excellence: Establish standards for evaluation, including automated and human-in-the-loop methods, benchmarking, and quality gates pre- and post-release.
* Model Optimization: Drive approaches to fine-tuning, distillation and reinforcement learning (including RL from feedback) to improve quality, cost and latency over off-the-shelf models.
* Production Observability: Set standards for telemetry, observability, monitoring, drift detection and cost management for AI systems in production.
* Emerging Tech to Production: Evaluate emerging models, frameworks and methods; run proofs of concept and translate them into robust, production-grade solutions.
* Enterprise Alignment: Partner with platform, data engineering, architecture, security and responsible-AI teams to ensure governance, compliance and reuse.
* Partner Communication: Translate complex technical concepts and trade-offs for senior non-technical partners and shape compelling use cases for AI investments.
* Talent Uplift and Representation: Mentor senior data scientists and ML engineers, raise the technical bar, and represent our work in internal forums and partner engagements.

**Essential Skills/Experience:**

**Minimum Requirements:**

* BS (or equivalent experience) in computer science, mathematics, statistics, engineering, physics, computational sciences or a related quantitative field.
* Extensive experience (typically 12+ years) building and deploying data science and ML solutions, including considerable recent hands-on experience (typically 2+ years) with LLM-based and agentic applications in production.
* Demonstrated track record of setting technical direction and leading complex, multi-functional AI delivery through influence.

**Mandatory Technical Skills:**

* Generative AI and LLMs: prompt and context engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, fine-tuning (including parameter-efficient methods), distillation, and model selection and cost/latency optimisation.
* Agentic AI: design and delivery of multi-agent systems using frameworks such as Amazon Bedrock AgentCore (or equivalents such as LangGraph, Strands or AutoGen), including tool integration, orchestration and guardrails.
* Evaluation and observability: LLM and agent evaluation methods and platforms, telemetry, tracing and monitoring of AI systems.
* Machine learning foundations: strong classical ML (supervised and unsupervised methods, statistical modelling) and deep learning, including transformers, using PyTorch or TensorFlow.
* Programming and tools: expert Python; SQL; scikit-learn; Jupyter; Streamlit or similar for rapid prototyping.
* Cloud and MLOps: AWS (SageMaker, Bedrock), CI/CD for ML, MLflow or equivalent experiment and model tracking, containerisation (Docker).

**Desirable Skills/Experience:**

* Master’s or PhD in machine learning, computer science or a related field. We prioritise demonstrated skills over credentials.
* Hands-on experience with reinforcement learning, including RLHF, RLAIF or other preference-optimisation methods.
* Experience with knowledge graphs, NLP, and structured and unstructured data (text and image).
* Experience with data and pipeline tooling such as Airflow, Spark and data-quality frameworks.
* Pharmaceutical, healthcare or commercial analytics domain experience (for example next-best-action, field-force, marketing or market-access analytics).
* Publications, patents or open-source contributions in AI/ML.
* Exceptional technical judgement, balancing innovation with pragmatism, risk and cost.
* Strong written and verbal communication, explaining complex methods to non-technical audiences.
* Collaborative approach to working with global, multi-functional teams.
* Curiosity and an aim to keep learning in a fast-moving field.

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.

**Why AstraZeneca:**

Here, your technical leadership meets meaningful scale: we build from the ground up as one team, connecting across the enterprise to convert complex data into practical insights that improve lives. AstraZeneca is a global, science-led, patient-focused biopharmaceutical company that focuses on the discovery, development and commercialization of prescription medicines for some of the world’s most serious diseases. But we’re more than one of the world’s leading pharmaceutical companies.

**Introduction to role:**

Are you ready to turn marketing automation into measurable impact for patients and company outcomes? In the position of Campaign Operations Analyst located in Chennai, you will be responsible for managing multi-channel campaigns using the Salesforce Marketing Cloud platform and Adobe Campaign. These campaigns help our medicines and programs reach the people who need them most. Your work will translate strategy into timely, relevant, and compliant communications that support brand objectives and patient outcomes.

You will join a collaborative, fast-moving team that brings marketers, data specialists, and technologists together to deliver at scale. * Campaign Build and Execution: Configure, build, test, and deliver emails, journeys, Cloud Pages, SMS, push notifications, and workflows across Adobe Campaign and the marketing cloud environment provided by Salesforce to meet defined business goals.

* Collaborate with IT and data teams to enable clean, reliable data flows and integrations from multiple sources. Apply schemas, supplementary data structures, and governance principles to ensure audiences remain accurate and compliant.
* Personalization and Targeting: Implement segmentation, multifaceted content, tailored strategies, classification systems, and targeting logic that increase relevance and performance across channels.
* Quality, Compliance, and Governance: Follow SOPs, SLAs, change control, and access standards; uphold privacy, consent, suppression, and preference management to protect customers and the business.
* Fix and Continuous Improvement: Diagnose and resolve workflow, delivery, journey, automation, and data issues; escalate appropriately and foster insights into platform and process improvements.
* Collaborator Partnership: Translate requirements from business partners into robust technical solutions; communicate progress, risks, and trade-offs clearly to diverse collaborators across regions.
* Reusable Assets and Scalability: Build and maintain templates, workflows, automations, and standard configurations that improve consistency, speed, and scale across markets.
* Measurement and Optimization: Supervise campaign health and delivery; validate audiences and outcomes, and recommend enhancements that boost efficiency, data quality, and engagement over time.

**Crucial Skills/Experience:**
------------------------------

* 4-6 years of overall experience in marketing automation with SFMC, covering modules such as Email Studio and Journey Builder, Interaction Studio, Einstein, Automation Studio, and Adobe Campaign.
* Hands-on experience with Adobe Campaign and/or the Salesforce digital marketing platform in a campaign operations or marketing automation environment.
* Practical knowledge of Adobe Campaign workflows, deliveries, targeting, segmentation, personalization, typologies, and schemas.
* Knowledge of SFMC capabilities including Email Studio, Journey Builder, Automation Studio, CloudPages, Data Extensions, and audience segmentation.
* Solid understanding of SQL; exposure to AMPscript, JavaScript, HTML/CSS, JSON, SOQL, APIs, and platform integrations is advantageous.
* Good understanding of campaign lifecycle management, data quality, audience segmentation, personalization, QA, and deployment processes.
* Understanding of data security, permission, blocking procedures, preference management, and access-control principles within marketing platforms.
* Strong analytical, solve, communication, and collaborator collaboration skills.
* Ability to work within established SOPs, SLAs, QA, change-management, and production deployment processes.
* Experience managing multiple campaign work in a fast-paced campaign operations environment while maintaining quality and timelines.

**Desirable Skills/Experience:**
--------------------------------

* Certifications in Marketing Cloud by Salesforce and/or Adobe Campaign.
* Sophisticated AMPscript and SSJS for personalization, CloudPages, and integrations.
* Experience with real-time and batch integrations using APIs, connectors, and event-based architectures.
* Knowledge of deliverability best practices, tracking, and testing tools across email and mobile channels.
* Familiarity with Agile delivery, backlog management, and version control for campaign assets.
* Experience in regulated industries and with regional data privacy requirements.

Join a mission-driven company where technology, data, and science come together to improve lives. We move with urgency, invest in modern platforms, and empower people to take smart risks while valuing kindness alongside ambition. **Would you enjoy working on our cutting-edge products?**

  

**About the Team**

Mercury is RX’s global registration and eCommerce platform, supporting the journeys that bring visitors and exhibitors to our events. It covers registration, purchasing, badging, and onsite access, connecting customer experiences with the data and business systems behind them. Our Product, Engineering, Design, Analytics, Product Success, and regional business teams work together to deliver reliable services, better customer experiences, and measurable business value.

  

**About the Role**

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager with strong communication, influencing, and product judgment skills who can build effective relationships across a complex, international business. You’ll help shape our registration and eCommerce capabilities by turning customer insights and business needs into prioritized opportunities and partnering with cross-functional teams to deliver meaningful outcomes.

Initially, you’ll have a significant role in go-to-market activity and business-unit engagement, working with regional teams to understand needs, assess readiness, remove adoption barriers, and support successful rollouts. As our operating model evolves, Product Success will take on more ongoing rollout coordination and day-to-day business engagement. You’ll help enable that transition, creating more capacity for product discovery, roadmap development, prioritization, and continuous improvement while remaining closely connected to customers and stakeholders and retaining responsibility for product decisions within your remit. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys understanding how products work in practice and using that insight to decide what should change and why.

  

**Responsibilities (What you’ll do)**

  

**Discover opportunities and shape product direction**

* Build a deep understanding of visitor, exhibitor, and event-team needs through research, stakeholder conversations, product data, and live-event observation.
* Look beyond feature requests to uncover underlying problems, test assumptions, and distinguish local needs from opportunities with broader value.
* Assess opportunities across registration, eCommerce, and related journeys, including improvements that support revenue growth, customer experience, data quality, and operational efficiency.
* Develop evidence-based recommendations and proportionate business cases that clearly explain benefits, risks, dependencies, and trade-offs.
* Own and maintain a prioritized opportunity backlog for your area and contribute to the broader product strategy and roadmap.
  

  

**Turn priorities into measurable improvements**

* Partner with Design, Engineering, Product Owners, and Business Analysts to translate validated opportunities into clear outcomes, scope, and requirements.
* Balance customer value and business priorities with technical feasibility, operational readiness, and the needs of a shared global platform.
* Work with adjacent product and business-system teams to manage dependencies across end-to-end journeys.
* Partner with Product Analytics to define success measures, establish baselines, and evaluate releases and experiments.
* Use launch results, customer feedback, and product performance to refine priorities and continuously improve the product.
  

  

**Partner with business units on rollout and adoption**

* Build strong relationships with stakeholders across registration, marketing, commercial, and event teams.
* Initially lead agreed product-engagement forums to clarify priorities, communicate roadmap decisions, and maintain visibility of adoption barriers and dependencies.
* Assess how well existing capabilities meet event requirements and determine whether process changes, configuration, or product development is the right response.
* Work with Product Success and delivery teams on launch readiness, pilots, and adoption plans, helping teams understand available capabilities and required business changes.
* Provide product input on significant issues through established support and escalation processes, ensuring recurring problems drive product improvements rather than repeated workarounds.
* Communicate decisions, constraints, and next steps clearly without committing ahead of discovery or delivery agreement.
  

  

**Help build a scalable Product–Product Success partnership**

* Establish clear responsibilities, decision-making boundaries, and feedback loops across Product, Product Success, and business units.
* Support the phased transfer of agreed go-to-market and stakeholder-coordination activities through shared documentation, knowledge transfer, and joint working.
* Maintain continuity for business units as responsibilities evolve, pacing handovers to agreed readiness and capacity.
* Equip Product Success colleagues with clear product context, value propositions, and guidance, while using their adoption insights to inform discovery.
* Retain ownership of product priorities and outcomes within your remit as more day-to-day engagement and coordination moves to Product Success.
  

**Requirements (What you’ll bring)**

* Experience managing digital products or a clearly defined product area, from problem discovery and opportunity prioritization through delivery and evaluation.
* Evidence of improvements that delivered customer or business outcomes, rather than simply completed features or project milestones.
* Strong discovery and analytical skills, including the ability to combine qualitative and quantitative evidence and recognize data limitations.
* Sound prioritization and commercial judgment, with the confidence to challenge assumptions, explain trade-offs, and constructively say “not yet.”
* Experience working closely with Engineering and Design teams in an agile product-development environment.
* Strong stakeholder-management skills, including influencing across functions and balancing regional needs with global product goals.
* Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain complex topics to technical and non-technical audiences, plus a practical understanding of rollout, adoption, and business change.
* The ability to learn complex workflows and integrations, navigate ambiguity, and stay focused on the highest-value problems.
  

**Useful, but not essential**

* Experience with registration, ticketing, eCommerce, payments, or other transaction-based digital products.
* Experience with global platforms serving multiple markets, business units, or customer groups.
* Familiarity with products connected to finance, CRM, identity, marketing, or reporting systems.
* Experience working with Product Success, Customer Success, or implementation teams on launches, adoption, and structured handovers.
* Experience with experimentation, conversion optimization, product analytics, or digital revenue growth.
* Experience in events or other time-critical environments where reliability and operational readiness are essential.
  

**What success looks like**

* Clear, evidence-based product priorities balancing customer needs, business value, and platform scalability.
* Product improvements with defined outcomes and measurable impact.
* Business units that understand product direction, adoption requirements, and the rationale behind decisions.
* Successful rollout and adoption of agreed capabilities, with risks and dependencies identified early.
* A sustainable partnership with Product Success, with responsibilities transferred progressively and without gaps in business engagement.
* More capacity for proactive discovery and continuous improvement, supported by strong customer and business insight.
  

**Why join us?**

You’ll work on a business-critical global platform with a direct connection to real customer experiences. The role combines hands-on business engagement with end-to-end product management, giving you the opportunity to shape both the product and how its value reaches customers.

  

**Work in a Way That Works for You**

We support a healthy work-life balance and flexible ways of working. Wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance, and sabbaticals can help you meet both immediate responsibilities and long-term goals.

  

**Working for You**

Your wellbeing is central to a long and successful career. Benefits include:

* Comprehensive health insurance for you, your immediate family, and parents.
* Enhanced health insurance options at company-negotiated rates.
* Group life insurance.
* Group accident insurance covering accidental death and permanent disability.
* Flexible working arrangements to support work-life balance.
* Employee Assistance Program for personal and work-related support.
* Medical screening.
* Maternity, paternity, and adoption support.
* Long-service awards.
* New baby gift.
* Subsidized meals in Chennai.
* Paid time off, including Casual Leave, Sick Leave, Privilege Leave, Compassionate Leave, Special Sick Leave, and Gazetted Public Holidays.
  

**About the Business**

RX is a global leader in events and exhibitions, using industry expertise, data, and technology to help individuals, communities, and organizations build their businesses. Operating in 25 countries across 41 industry sectors, RX hosts approximately 350 events each year and is committed to an inclusive workplace. RX is part of RELX, a global provider of information-based analytics and decision tools for professional and business customers. For more information, visit http://www.rxglobal.com

We are committed to providing a fair and accessible hiring process. If you have a disability or other need that requires accommodation or adjustment, please let us know by completing our Applicant Request Support Form or please contact 1-855-833-5120.

**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Work Mode:** Work from Office  
**Experience:** 2–5 Years  
**Salary:** Up to ₹12 LPA (Based on relevant experience and last drawn CTC)

**About the Company**

Saravana Engineering & Infratech Pvt. Ltd. is an engineering company operating across Solar EPC, Battery Manufacturing, Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), Electric Vehicles (EV), Industrial IoT, and Smart Infrastructure.

We are looking for an organised and proactive **Business Executive – Battery Products** to support our battery product sales and business development activities through CRM management, sales coordination, documentation, quotation preparation, order tracking, and internal coordination.

The candidate will work closely with the Sales Executive, Business Development Manager, technical team, and other departments to ensure smooth business operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Sales & Business Development Support**

* Support the Sales Executive in daily sales and business development activities.
* Coordinate with the sales team regarding customer enquiries and follow-ups.
* Maintain customer, dealer, distributor, and business partner databases.
* Assist in identifying potential business opportunities and maintaining prospect records.
* Coordinate customer meetings, product presentations, and business discussions.
* Track pending enquiries and ensure timely follow-ups.

**2. CRM & Sales Pipeline Management**

* Maintain and regularly update CRM records and sales pipeline information.
* Track leads, customer enquiries, quotations, purchase orders, and order status.
* Ensure accurate entry of customer details and communication history.
* Monitor pending leads and coordinate follow-ups with the sales team.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly sales pipeline reports.

* Maintain customer records and commercial documentation.
* Coordinate with technical and commercial teams to collect information required for proposals.

* Support tender-related documentation and submission coordination when required.

* Coordinate with production, technical, procurement, and service teams.
* Monitor order progress and share updates with the sales team.
* Assist in resolving documentation and coordination-related issues.
* Ensure timely communication of customer requirements to internal teams.

* Maintain customer and dealer communication records.
* Assist with dealer onboarding documentation and business coordination.
* Coordinate customer enquiries and direct technical queries to the appropriate teams.
* Support customer relationship management activities.

* Maintain records of potential customers, dealers, and business opportunities.
* Prepare regular business development and sales support reports.

* 2–5 years of experience in business development support, sales coordination, or a similar role.

* Good knowledge of MS Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and email communication.
* Experience using CRM tools and maintaining sales pipeline records.
* Good documentation, coordination, and follow-up skills.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to coordinate with customers and multiple internal departments.

* Inverter and industrial batteries.
* EV and energy storage products.
* Electrical and electronic products.
* Automobile and engineering industries.
* Industrial equipment and power solutions.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
**Job Title:** Marketing Manager

**Location:** Chennai (Onsite)

**Job Type:** Full-Time

### **About Us**

Digient Technologies is a dynamic and innovative B2B online iGaming company, dedicated to providing cutting-edge solutions in the rapidly evolving iGaming industry. We pride ourselves on delivering high-quality products and services that enable our clients to stay ahead in the competitive landscape of online iGaming.

### **Job Summary**

We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Marketing Professional to lead and execute comprehensive marketing strategies for our software product development and services company. This role will focus on brand building, managing our corporate website, overseeing event management, and driving social media marketing initiatives. The ideal candidate will have a strong grasp of digital marketing, excellent project management skills, and the ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams to enhance our brand visibility and generate quality leads.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**Brand Building & Strategy:**

* Develop and implement innovative marketing strategies to enhance brand awareness and market positioning.
* Collaborate with leadership to define brand messaging, visual identity, and value proposition.
* Monitor industry trends and competitor activities to identify opportunities for brand growth.

**Corporate Website Management:**

* Oversee the maintenance, content updates, and optimization of the corporate website.

**Technical Skills:**

* Familiarity with website management and content optimization strategies.
* Hands-on experience with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini for content creation, campaign planning, and market research.
* Ability to use AI-powered marketing tools for SEO, social media management, automation, and campaign analysis.
* Ability to review and refine AI-generated content for accuracy, quality, and brand consistency.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Strong project management, organizational, and multitasking abilities.
* Creative thinker with a data-driven approach to decision-making.

* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and adapt to changing priorities.
* Strategic mindset with the ability to translate business objectives into actionable marketing plans.

title: Head of South Asia
description:
**Head Of South Asia**

**Are you ready to shape the future of India’s petrochemicals and energy markets by turning powerful market intelligence into game-changing growth opportunities?**  
**Do you have experience in Leadership Role** ?

  

**About the Business**

At ICIS, our mission is to optimize the world’s resources. We help companies make strategic, sustainable decisions by bringing transparency to markets across the world. We create a comprehensive view of commodities markets, providing companies with the data and intelligence to successfully navigate across global value chains every day. Our customers benefit from instant access to price assessments, reports and forecasts, a dedicated news channel and supply and demand data. You can learn more about ICIS at the link below. https://www.icis.com/explore

**About our Team**

Our teams are fueled by curiosity, relentlessly pursuing better customer outcomes. We're on a mission to deliver unparalleled customer experience, excelling in communication. In a fast-paced environment, we thrive, embracing change with flexibility and composure under pressure. Our high-energy, self-motivated individuals are driven by a genuine desire to make a positive mark on our business. But that's not all we're creative problem solvers with an entrepreneurial spirit.

  
  

**About the Role**

ICIS is seeking an accomplished leader to lead the sales function, directing people leaders and professionals toward the achievement of departmental commercial objectives. This role is responsible for developing sales plans and establishing priorities, allocating resources effectively, and overseeing execution across teams. The successful candidate will apply deep functional expertise to complex business challenges and contribute to the development of sales strategy and policy.

  

**Responsibilities**

* **Leadership and Direction** - Identify and communicate the actions needed to implement the function's strategy and business plan within the business area or department; explain the relationship to the broader organization's mission, vision, and values; motivate people to commit to these tenets and do extraordinary things to achieve local business goals.
* **Customer Relationship Development / Prospecting** - Develop and implement relationship management plans for complex potential customer accounts to identify and build relationships with relevant decision-makers and influencers within the customer organization and to enable effective two-way flow of information and resolution of issues.
* **Sales Opportunities Creation** - Develop a personal network within the business sector and represent the organization at business sector events. Obtain market intelligence and enhance the visibility and reputation of the organization, its products, and its services.
* **Sell Customer Propositions** - Configure a complex product-and-services solution and associated contractual terms that meet the customer's mid- to long-term needs, taking input from relevant internal specialists. Present the solution to customer representatives and negotiate agreement within a predefined range of commercial parameters, or, alternately, review sales proposals from team members and authorize those that deviate from standard terms, escalating issues to senior management where appropriate.
* **Promoting Customer Focus** - Develop internal marketing plans and work collaboratively with other departments to improve internal relationships and build strong external customer relationships.
* **Customer Relationship Management (CRM) Data** - Oversee the implementation and maintenance of the CRM system within the area of responsibility, identifying and communicating opportunities for system improvement that may enhance the management of customer relationships.
* **Performance Management** - Manage and report on the performance of a substantial, diverse team; set appropriate performance objectives for direct reports or project/account team members and hold individuals accountable for achieving them; take appropriate corrective action where necessary to ensure the achievement of team/personal objectives.
* **Organizational Capability Building** - Use the organization's formal development framework to identify the team's individual development needs. Plan and implement actions, including continuing professional development specified by professional or regulatory institutions, to build their professional capabilities. Provide informal training or coaching to others throughout the organization in own area of expertise to enable others to improve performance and fulfill personal potential.
* **Policy Development and Implementation** - Develop procedures and interpret and apply policy for area of expertise to achieve specified outputs, or advise the wider business on application of policy, then monitor implementation of those procedures within the organization.
* **Business Planning** - Contribute to the development of annual and longer-term business plans; forecast performance against business key performance indicators (KPIs); develop business cases for key activities/projects; and estimate the financial and human resources required to deliver performance targets.
* **Budgeting** - Develop and/or deliver budget plans with guidance from senior colleagues.
* **Operational Compliance** - Monitor and review performance and behaviors within area of responsibility to identify and resolve noncompliance with the organization's policies and relevant regulatory codes and codes of conduct.
* **Sales** - Sell a range of products and services to significant customers and/or manage a sales team for a given area.
* **Sales Incentives Management** - Oversee the development and management of sales incentive programs across multiple sales teams, aligning incentives with the organization's broader sales strategies.
* **Stakeholder Management** - Develop and implement stakeholder engagement plans for projects to identify relevant stakeholders, to develop positive stakeholder relationships, and to ensure that each stakeholder has an appropriate share of voice.
* **Business Performance Metrics** - Control specific segments of the organization's business performance metrics, ensuring strategic alignment with financial goals and objectives.

  

**Requirements**

* **Experience** : Experience of planning and managing resources to deliver predetermined objectives as specified by more senior managers (Over 3 years to 6 years)
* **Leadership & Strategic Direction** – Proven ability to translate business strategy into priorities and drive commercial results.
* **Customer Relationship Management** – Strong capability to build and manage relationships with senior decision-makers across complex accounts.
* **Sales & Business Development** – Demonstrated expertise in prospecting, market intelligence, networking, and opportunity creation.
* **Solution Selling & Negotiation** – Proven ability to develop tailored solutions and negotiate complex commercial agreements.
* **Team Performance Management** – Strong experience setting objectives, managing performance, coaching teams, and developing capability.
* **Business Planning & Compliance** – Demonstrated ability to manage business plans, budgets, KPIs, policies, and regulatory requirements.
* **Stakeholder Management** – Proven ability to engage and influence internal and external stakeholders effectively.
* **Commercial & CRM Management** – Strong understanding of CRM effectiveness, sales incentives, and commercial performance metrics.
* **Understanding** -Strong understanding of India’s petrochemical, refining, energy, chemical, and associated industrial value chains.

  
  

**We know that your wellbeing and happiness are key to a long and successful career. These are some of the benefits we are delighted to offer:**

* Comprehensive Health Insurance: Covers you, your immediate family, and parents.
* Enhanced Health Insurance Options: Competitive rates negotiated by the company.
* Group Life Insurance: Ensuring financial security for your loved ones.
* Group Accident Insurance: Extra protection for accidental death and permanent disablement.
* Flexible Working Arrangement: Achieve a harmonious work-life balance.
* Employee Assistance Program: Access support for personal and work-related challenges.
* Medical Screening: Your well-being is a top priority.
* Modern Family Benefits: Maternity, paternity, and adoption support.
* Long-Service Awards: Recognizing dedication and commitment.
* New Baby Gift: Celebrating the joy of parenthood.
* Subsidized Meals in Chennai: Enjoy delicious meals at discounted rates.
* Various Paid Time Off: Take time off with Casual Leave, Sick Leave, Privilege Leave, Compassionate Leave, Special Sick Leave, and Gazetted Public Holidays.
* Free Transport pick up and drop from the home -office - home (applies in Chennai)

title: Specialty Care Partner, Nerandomilast
description:
The Position

Are you passionate about making a meaningful impact on patients' lives while building strong partnerships within the healthcare community? As a Specialty Care Partner, you will be at the forefront of representing Boehringer Ingelheim's innovative specialty products, helping healthcare professionals understand how our therapies can improve patient outcomes.

  

Job Purpose:

To effectively represent and promote Boehringer Ingelheim specialty products to existing and potential customers, by presenting how Boehringer Ingelheim products benefit their patients, with the objective of maximizing sales revenue and increasing market share, also to offer innovative, tailored solutions for key accounts ensuring long term presence of Boehringer Ingelheim portfolio whilst adhering to best practice principles and Boehringer Ingelheim’s standard operational procedures (SOPs).

Location: Mumbai, Delhi, Bengaluru, Kolkata, Hyderabad, Chennai, Pune, Ahmedabad, Jaipur, Chandigarh, Lucknow, and Kochi.

  

Duties & Responsibilities

Sales Planning:

* Builds and executes an effective Sales Action Plan with the objective of maximizing BI business in assigned accounts and to ensure achievement of sales and market share targets/objectives.
* Monitors the sales development and performance of Boehringer Ingelheim products.
  

Sales Execution:

* Works closely with Regional Sales Manager in executing an effective Sales Action Plan with the objective of maximizing BI business in assigned territory to ensure achievement of territory sales targets/objectives.
* Plans and schedules daily visits with existing and potential customers to deliver BI’s assigned core product message.
* Records and tracks product sales and customers in his/her region.
* Obtains and records feedback from existing customer on competitor’s product performance and monitors their activity.
* Secures consistent and sustainable growth in sales and revenue by identifying and developing new market opportunities.
* Precise & full understanding and utilization of medical knowledge about therapeutic area and related products.
* Successfully completes all training requirements, including product examinations and ensures compliance to all external regulations and internal SOPs
  

Account Management:

* Obtain and provide information about the development in accounts on their purchasing medicines and developments regarding healthcare projects.
* Listing of products in all accounts through the value proposition of products to the payers and P&T committee and the decision makers.
* Monitor the competition intelligence activities on Key Accounts.
Achieve or exceed overall sales targets via appropriate resource utilization as well as routine and frequent visits to key stakeholders such as chief pharmacists, paramedics, decision makers and related specialists.  

Stakeholder Management:

* Build strong and long partnership with all key stakeholders and ensure their full awareness of BI product benefits to the patients.
* Propose customized partnership programs for both prescriber and payers that need to build the productive business relation between the account and BI.
* Establish and maintain ongoing, long-term collaborative relationships with stakeholders.
* Share stakeholder insights and information within Boehringer Ingelheim to strengthen relevant activities, e.g., product development, marketing, sales efforts.
  

Building capability and knowledge in healthcare ecosystem:

* Build knowledge and understanding about BI overall value proposition, and product's labeled indications and efficacy data among all relevant stakeholders in the Multiple Disciplinary Teams and Decision Making Unit.
* Conduct science-based discussions with HCPs and effective speaker programs with physician advocates and KOLs as per the approved indications of BI products.
* Arrange multidisciplinary workshops for physicians and other healthcare professionals.
* Actively support R&I paramedics on patient support programs and other relevant engagements.

**About our Future Employee**

* Education : Bachelors or higher degree in Pharma or Life Sciences
* Must have 4+ years of sales experience with Pharma sector with at least 2 years in Specialty / Super Specialty / Key Account Management domain.
* High performer in sales, cross-functional engagement, strong business acumen.
* Organizational skills, good analytical skills / mindset, ability to manage complexity with a high degree of maturity.

title: Delivery Owner
description:
**Delivery Owner**

  

**Ready to put your attention to detail to work, ensuring accurate orders, seamless deliveries and timely invoicing?**

**Want to combine your operations experience and analytical skills with AI tools to streamline workflows and drive process improvements?**

  

**About our Team**

The Corporate Markets – Pharma group is the leading provider of content based marketing services to the pharmaceutical, medical device, and biotech industries. We build on Elsevier’s strong content position and relationships with healthcare professionals to help our clients reach their desired audience with best-in-class clinical content that only Elsevier can deliver. We are leaders in what we do

  

**About the Role**

The Delivery Owner is primarily responsible for delivering Global Pharma products to customers. Typically specializing in one or more products while understanding deliverables across all of them, they work only on products approved by pre-delivery owners and ensure delivery is high quality and on schedule. Reporting to the Product Delivery Lead, they proactively flag delivery control issues, hand off deliverables with the agreed proof of delivery to Post-Delivery Owners for checks, and help document delivery procedures for old and new products. They strive to improve agreed KPIs through continuous improvement and standardized delivery across regions, may interact with customers to clarify deliverables, and manage multiple priorities, AI adoption and complexity while collaborating closely with Pre-Delivery Owners, Post-Delivery Owners and other Delivery Owners for end-to-end delivery.

  

**Responsibilities:**

* **Own end-to-end product delivery** from completion of pre-delivery approvals through successful customer delivery, building strong expertise in assigned Global Pharma products while remaining flexible to support other products as business needs and volumes require.
* **Ensure delivery readiness and compliance** by validating that editorial decisions, approvals, customer requirements and other prerequisites are complete before starting delivery, proactively challenging or escalating any gaps.
* **Manage stakeholders and delivery dependencies** by working closely with Pre-delivery and Post-delivery Owners and coordinating with publishers, printers, Journal Managers, Editors, Compliance and other relevant stakeholders to clarify requirements, resolve issues and ensure successful delivery.
* **Complete delivery closure and enable timely billing** by accurately documenting Proof of Delivery, providing the required information for invoicing and collaborating with Post-delivery Owners to resolve customer billing queries.
* **Track and control delivery performance** using appropriate tools and dashboards to monitor actual delivery times, turnaround times, volumes, quality, compliance and agreed metrics, supporting predictable delivery and revenue forecasting.
* **Drive continuous improvement, AI adoption and innovation** by identifying opportunities to simplify and standardise processes, reduce manual effort and duplication, and responsibly leverage approved AI, automation and existing Elsevier tools and dashboards to improve efficiency, accuracy, quality and predictability, while sharing successful practices and demonstrating measurable benefits.

title: SEO Specialist
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a results-driven **SEO Specialist** with 2–4 years of hands-on experience in Search Engine Optimization (SEO), Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), and Large Language Model Optimization (LLMO).

The ideal candidate should have a strong technical understanding of how search engines and AI-powered search platforms discover, crawl, index, interpret, and recommend content.

We are not looking for someone who simply knows how to add keywords to websites or publish blogs. We need someone who can build and execute strategies that improve organic visibility, search rankings, website traffic, qualified leads, and brand presence across traditional search engines and AI-powered platforms.

**Most importantly, you must have a proven track record of delivering measurable results.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Technical SEO**

* Conduct comprehensive technical SEO audits and implement corrective actions.
* Manage website crawling, indexing, canonicalization, redirects, XML sitemaps, and robots.txt.
* Optimize Core Web Vitals, page speed, mobile usability, and website architecture.
* Implement structured data and Schema Markup.
* Identify and resolve technical SEO issues affecting organic visibility.
* Work with developers to implement technical SEO recommendations.

**2. AEO – Answer Engine Optimization**

* Optimize website content to appear in featured snippets, People Also Ask, and answer-based search results.
* Structure content for conversational and question-based search queries.
* Implement relevant FAQ, HowTo, Organization, and other applicable schema markup.
* Develop strategies to improve visibility across answer engines.

**3. GEO – Generative Engine Optimization**

* Develop strategies to improve brand and content visibility in AI-generated search results.
* Optimize content for AI discovery, contextual relevance, and citations.
* Understand how generative search platforms retrieve, interpret, and reference information.
* Improve brand authority, topical relevance, and entity recognition.
* Monitor brand visibility and citations across AI search experiences.

**4. LLMO – Large Language Model Optimization**

* Understand how LLMs interpret, retrieve, and reference website content.
* Optimize content architecture for AI discoverability and machine readability.
* Build topical authority through structured content and relevant information architecture.
* Improve brand presence and factual consistency across AI-driven discovery platforms.

**5. Content & On-Page SEO**

* Conduct keyword research, search intent analysis, and competitor analysis.
* Develop keyword mapping and content optimization strategies.
* Optimize titles, meta descriptions, headings, internal links, and page structures.
* Build topic clusters and content hubs.
* Work closely with content writers to create search-focused content.

**6. Link Building & Off-Page SEO**

* Develop ethical link-building and digital PR strategies.
* Identify relevant backlink opportunities.
* Improve domain authority and brand mentions through relevant publications and websites.
* Monitor backlink profiles and identify harmful links.

**7. Analytics & Performance**

* Track and report keyword rankings, organic traffic, conversions, and qualified leads.
* Monitor Google Search Console and Google Analytics 4.
* Track visibility across traditional search engines and AI-powered search platforms.
* Identify performance gaps and implement improvement strategies.
* Present measurable outcomes through regular performance reports.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 2–4 years of hands-on SEO experience.
* Strong technical knowledge of SEO, AEO, GEO, and LLMO.
* Proven experience improving organic rankings and website traffic.
* Demonstrable experience with technical SEO audits and implementation.
* Strong understanding of search engine algorithms and AI-driven search.
* Expertise in keyword research, search intent, content optimization, and link building.
* Understanding of structured data, Schema Markup, and website architecture.
* Ability to independently plan, execute, monitor, and optimize SEO campaigns.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

**Tools & Platforms**

Hands-on experience with several of the following:

* Google Search Console
* Google Analytics 4 (GA4)
* Ahrefs / SEMrush / Moz
* Screaming Frog SEO Spider
* Google PageSpeed Insights
* Sitebulb
* Schema Markup Validator
* Google Rich Results Test
* Looker Studio
* AI search visibility and monitoring tools

**What We Expect From You**

We value execution and measurable outcomes over certificates and theoretical knowledge.

You should be able to demonstrate:

* Websites where you have improved organic search traffic.
* Keywords and pages where you have achieved significant ranking improvements.
* Technical SEO issues you have identified and resolved.
* Examples of content that has gained search visibility.
* Results from AEO, GEO, or LLMO initiatives, wherever you have implemented them.
* Your contribution to generating organic enquiries or business leads.

**Candidates must be prepared to discuss actual projects, strategies implemented, challenges faced, and results achieved during the interview.**

**Apply Now**

If you understand the future of search and know how to turn SEO, AEO, GEO, and LLMO strategies into measurable business results, we would love to hear from you.

Send your resume along with examples of SEO projects, case studies, or websites you have worked on.

**Why choose AstraZeneca India?**
---------------------------------

Help push the boundaries of science to deliver life-changing medicines to patients. After 45 years in India, we’re continuing to secure a future where everyone can access affordable, sustainable, innovative healthcare.

The part you play in our business will be challenging, yet rewarding, requiring you to use your resilient, collaborative and diplomatic skillsets to make connections. Calling all tech innovators, ownership takers, challenge seekers and proactive collaborators. At AstraZeneca, breakthroughs born in the lab become transformative medicine for the world's most complex diseases. We empower people like you to push the boundaries of science, challenge convention, and unleash your entrepreneurial spirit. You'll embrace differences and take bold actions to drive the change needed to meet global healthcare and sustainability challenges.

Here, diverse minds and bold disruptors can meaningfully impact the future of healthcare using cutting-edge technology. Whether you join us in Bengaluru or Chennai, you can make a tangible impact within a global biopharmaceutical company that invests in your future. Join a talented global team that's powering AstraZeneca to better serve patients every day.

**Success Profile**
-------------------

Ready to make an impact in your career? If you're passionate, growth-orientated and a true team player, we'll help you succeed. Here are some of the skills and capabilities we look for.

### **Tech innovators**

Make a greater impact through our digitally enabled enterprise. Use your skills in data and technology to transform and optimise our operations, helping us deliver meaningful work that changes lives.

### **Ownership takers**

If you're a self-aware self-starter who craves autonomy, AstraZeneca provides the perfect environment to take ownership and grow. Here, you'll feel empowered to lead and reach excellence at every level — with unrivalled support when you need it.

### **Challenge seekers**

Adapting and advancing our progress means constantly challenging the status quo. In this dynamic environment where everything we do has urgency and focus, you'll have the ability to show up, speak up and confidently take smart risks.

### **Proactive collaborators**

Your unique perspectives make our ambitions and capabilities possible. Our culture of sharing ideas, learning and improving together helps us consistently set the bar higher. As a proactive collaborator, you'll seek out ways to bring people together to achieve their best.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**Job ID** R-262808 **Date posted** 10/30/2026

**Career Level - D3**

**Introduction to role**

Are you ready to leverage your forecasting expertise to impact patients and ultimately save lives? As a Manager in Forecasting at AstraZeneca, you'll be at the forefront of transforming our ability to develop life-changing medicines. Based at Manyata Tech Park, Bangalore, and working a hybrid shift from 2 PM to 11 PM IST, you'll collaborate with global teams to drive strategic brand forecasts. Join us in a dynamic environment where your insights will guide brand strategy and contribute to our mission of pushing the boundaries of science.

**Accountabilities**
--------------------

As a Forecast Manager, you will work closely with the Forecast Leader and cross-functional teams to develop brand forecasts for strategic brands and early assets. You will be responsible for creating and maintaining forecast models, identifying key business issues, and incorporating research results into forecasts. Your role will also involve leading a team of forecasters, ensuring quality outputs, and driving continuous improvement activities. Collaborate extensively with internal and external stakeholders to resolve process-related issues and optimize forecasting processes.

**Essential Skills/Experience**
-------------------------------

* 15+ years of direct Pharmaceutical forecasting experience with a solid knowledge of forecasting techniques, models and approaches
* Experience utilizing a range of data sources and analytics involving standard data in the Pharmaceutical industry – e.g. IQVIA (MIDAS, DDD NPA, Monthly Xponent), claims data (Truven, Marketscan), epidemiological data, etc. For US forecasting, experience with TRx / NBRx / NRx data and methodologies
* Strong analytical expertise; superior Excel, financial modelling and forecasting skills
* Project management experience including risk mitigation, planning and running multiple projects running in parallel
* Ability to build trusted relationships across a range of partner groups including Marketing, Analytics, Operations, and Technology
* Demonstrated experience in problem solving and continuous improvement
* Strong written and verbal communication

**Desirable Skills/Experience**
-------------------------------

* Good understanding of multiple disease areas and how patients move through their respective diagnosis and treatment pathways, including treatment dynamics
* Experience integrating insights from market research and secondary data analysis into forecast assumptions
* Knowledge of advanced statistical forecast methodologies and applied AI / ML / automation
* Understand working on a forecasting platform – including transitioning current BAU to a forecasting platform
* Experience working with Power Apps, specifically PowerBI
* For US forecasting, working knowledge of US Market Access and gross-to-net

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.

At AstraZeneca, we are driven by a purpose-led mission to push the boundaries of science and discover life-changing medicines. Our work has a direct impact on patients, empowering us to perform at our peak by combining cutting-edge science with leading digital technology platforms. We are committed to innovation and collaboration, creating new ways of working that drive exponential growth. With a focus on technology and data solutions, we are transforming the industry and making a meaningful impact every day.

Ready to make a difference? to join our team and be part of something bigger!

description:
**Designation :** **Associate Director**

**Level : L5**

**Location :** **Chennai**

**Experience : 11 to 17 Years**

  
  

**Job Role** :

You will be the senior analytics and AI leader for a set of Technology and Media & Communications clients- the person who owns the client relationship, shapes the analytics and AI roadmap, and makes sure it ships into production and moves a business metric.

Clients in these groups are digital-native and run product telemetry, clickstream, ad-impression and subscriber data at billions of rows, and they buy outcomes (net revenue retention, ARPU, ad yield, cost to serve), not dashboards. The role therefore blends three things: a consulting partner who can hold a VP-level conversation, a data science leader who can review a causal model or an LLM evaluation plan, and a P&L owner who grows the account.

You will also build the practice: reusable accelerators, GenAI and agentic solutions for these industries, and a lead and groom reporting members to run accounts independently.

  
  

**Responsibilities** :

**Client and account leadership**

* Own multiple strategic accounts end to end: relationship, delivery, margin and growth, with Director/VP/CXO stakeholders in product, growth, marketing, revenue operations, finance and similar functions.

* Work with the client & internal teams to build analytics and AI roadmap per account, prioritizing use cases by value, feasibility and data readiness.

* Grow accounts by identifying new problem spaces, writing proposals and SOWs, and converting pilots into multi-year programs.

* Run quarterly business reviews that tie delivered work to client KPIs and documented value.

**Solution design and delivery excellence**

* Translate ambiguous business problems into analytical framings, solution architectures and delivery plans across analytics, data science, ML engineering and data engineering.

* Collaborate with AI CoE and act as technical co-reviewer on model design, experimentation, causal inference, forecasting and GenAI/LLM solutions; challenge assumptions and validate business logic.

* Ensure models reach production with MLOps discipline: versioning, monitoring, drift detection, retraining and documentation.

* Govern delivery health across onsite–offshore teams: scope, estimates, risk, quality gates, utilisation and gross margin.

**GenAI, agentic AI and innovation**

* Support teams in design of GenAI use cases such as conversational analytics, sales and support copilots, content tagging and summarisation, and agentic workflows for marketing and customer operations.

* Set standards for LLM evaluation, guardrails, cost-per-query and responsible AI (privacy, bias, IP and content-rights constraints common in media).

* Partner with hyperscaler and platform alliances (AWS, Azure, GCP, Databricks, Snowflake) on joint solutions and go-to-market as needed.

**Solution building and thought leadership**

* Build reusable accelerators and IP for the industry groups (for example, SaaS churn-and-expansion kit, Media Mix tool kit...).

* Support sales for new logos: discovery workshops, solution demos and orals.

* Publish points of view, speak at industry forums and contribute to analyst briefings.

**People leadership**

* Lead 25–60 people through Managers and Senior Managers; own hiring, staffing, performance calibration and promotions for the portfolio.

* Develop successors who can independently run an account.

* Build a culture of rigour, client focus and continuous learning, including GenAI upskilling.

  

**Required skills** :

10+ years in analytics, data science or AI consulting or a captive analytics/CoE (preferably focused on Tech B2B SaaS or Media & Ent ).

familiarity with at least one cloud (AWS, Azure or GCP) and modern data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery); understanding of MLOps (MLflow, Airflow, CI/CD). • Delivered at least one GenAI/LLM solution beyond proof of concept, including evaluation and guardrails.

Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.

Mandatory to successfully complete Anti-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post-course assessment, as required

**Why choose AstraZeneca India?**
---------------------------------

Help push the boundaries of science to deliver life-changing medicines to patients. After 45 years in India, we’re continuing to secure a future where everyone can access affordable, sustainable, innovative healthcare.

The part you play in our business will be challenging, yet rewarding, requiring you to use your resilient, collaborative and diplomatic skillsets to make connections. The majority of your work will be field based, and will require you to be highly-organised, planning your monthly schedule, attending meetings and calls, as well as writing up reports.

-----------------------

Calling all tech innovators, ownership takers, challenge seekers and proactive collaborators. At AstraZeneca, breakthroughs born in the lab become transformative medicine for the world's most complex diseases. We empower people like you to push the boundaries of science, challenge convention, and unleash your entrepreneurial spirit. You'll embrace differences and take bold actions to drive the change needed to meet global healthcare and sustainability challenges.

Here, diverse minds and bold disruptors can meaningfully impact the future of healthcare using cutting-edge technology. Whether you join us in Bengaluru or Chennai, you can make a tangible impact within a global biopharmaceutical company that invests in your future. Join a talented global team that's powering AstraZeneca to better serve patients every day.

**Success Profile**
-------------------

Ready to make an impact in your career? If you're passionate, growth-orientated and a true team player, we'll help you succeed. Here are some of the skills and capabilities we look for.

### **Tech innovators**

Make a greater impact through our digitally enabled enterprise. Use your skills in data and technology to transform and optimise our operations, helping us deliver meaningful work that changes lives.

### **Ownership takers**

If you're a self-aware self-starter who craves autonomy, AstraZeneca provides the perfect environment to take ownership and grow. Here, you'll feel empowered to lead and reach excellence at every level — with unrivalled support when you need it.

### **Challenge seekers**

Adapting and advancing our progress means constantly challenging the status quo. In this dynamic environment where everything we do has urgency and focus, you'll have the ability to show up, speak up and confidently take smart risks.

### **Proactive collaborators**

Your unique perspectives make our ambitions and capabilities possible. Our culture of sharing ideas, learning and improving together helps us consistently set the bar higher. As a proactive collaborator, you'll seek out ways to bring people together to achieve their best.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**Job ID** R-262639 **Date posted** 10/25/2026

**GCL : D1**
------------

**Introduction to role:**
-------------------------

Are you ready to turn complex data into clear, confident decisions that shape the future of life-changing medicines? In this role, you will develop patient, volume, and revenue forecasts for strategic brands and early assets across Global priority markets and the US—work that directly informs brand strategy, investment decisions, and how we reach patients faster!

Based at Manyata Tech Park, Bangalore on a hybrid schedule (three days a week in office) with a 2 PM - 11 PM IST shift, you will partner closely with forecasting leadership and Commercial teams. You will build and own models that set performance expectations, provide clarity on risk and opportunity, and guide cross-functional teams toward decisive action. Do you thrive in a dynamic environment where your analysis sparks strategy and your point of view earns trust?

**Accountabilities:**
---------------------

* Develop and own forecast models. Build, validate, and maintain strong short-term and long-term models. These models reflect current data, assumptions, and market dynamics for key brands and initial assets.
* Decision Support: Translate insights into clear recommendations, expertly defend methodologies and assumptions, and influence cross-functional collaborators with clear logic and quantified confidence.
* Cross-Functional Alignment: Align forecast assumptions and analytical outputs with partners in Marketing, Sales, Market Access and Pricing, Finance, Analytics, and Sales Operations to ensure a single, trusted view of demand.
* New Product Introduction: Develop volume forecasts for launches to feed strategic and operational planning, informing resourcing, supply, and market activation.
* Data and Methodology Difficulty: Identify and apply the right data sources and industry-leading approaches; integrate primary research and secondary data to ensure objectivity and comprehensive coverage.
* Sensitivity and Scenario Analysis: Conduct simulations and ranges (including Monte Carlo as appropriate) to clarify uncertainty, quantify upside/downside, and support risk management.
* Global Pipeline and Early Assets: Create new forecast frameworks as business needs emerge for pipeline assets, lifecycle management, and business development opportunities.
* US Planning Cadence: For US-focused work, participate in S&OP processes, submit volumes, and build weekly, monthly, and annual models and conversions aligned to commercial rhythms.
* Continuous Improvement: Evolve forecasting capabilities through innovation in methodologies, automation, and tools; champion standard processes that improve speed, reliability, and decision quality.
* Documentation and Communication: Deliver forecasts with clear, accessible documentation of assumptions, confidence levels, and key drivers; proactively surface issues that matter to the business.

**Essential Skills/Experience:**
--------------------------------

* Bachelor’s Degree in relevant field
* 6+ years of direct Pharmaceutical forecasting experience with an in-depth knowledge of forecasting techniques, models and approaches
* Good understanding of multiple disease areas, with experience in rare diseases/ OBU including how patients move through their respective diagnosis and treatment pathways, including treatment dynamics
* Experience integrating insights from market research and secondary data analysis into forecast assumptions
* Experience using a range of data sources and analytics involving standard data in the Pharmaceutical industry – e.g. IQVIA (MIDAS, DDD NPA, Monthly Xponent), claims data (Truven, Marketscan), epidemiological data, etc. For US forecasting, experience with TRx / NBRx / NRx data and methodologies
* Strong analytical expertise; excellent Excel, financial modelling and forecasting skills
* Ability to build trusted relationships across a range of partner groups including Marketing, Analytics, Operations, and Technology
* Confirmed experience in problem solving and continuous improvement
* Strong written and verbal communication

**Desirable Skills/Experience:**
--------------------------------

* Advanced degree or equivalent experience preferred (e.g., PhD, MBA, Masters)
* Knowledge and experience in sophisticated statistical forecast methodologies and applied AI / ML / automation
* Experience working with Power Apps, specifically PowerBI
* For US forecasting, confirmed understanding of US Market Access and gross-to-net

**Why AstraZeneca:**
--------------------

Join a high-performing, digitally savvy community where bold thinking is encouraged and supported. Here,unexpected teams come together to ignite bold ideas, using advanced technology and data to accelerate decisions impacting patients. You will have the freedom to think differently, take balanced risks, and see your work drive tangible change across the enterprise. We value persistence alongside ambition, and you will grow your craft by learning from bright minds who challenge and support one another every day.

-------------------
